newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end subdued, trade moderately higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end subdued, trade moderately higher.

text.p: Tokyo stocks finished a subdued session moderately higher Thursday, supported by a rally in shares of semiconductor equipment makers and bargain hunting in other blue-chip issues, brokers said.
The market was also relieved by Mitsui Construction Co Ltd's restructuring plan announced Wednesday, giving a boost to the contractor's shares, but many other builders lost ground, they said.
The Nikkei 225 average climbed 214.02 points or 1.13 percent to close at 19,222.62. September Nikkei futures rose 250 points to 19,280.
"Since futures-linked selling was withering, that encouraged investors to bargain-hunt blue-chip shares," said Kaoru Ichikawa, a senior trader at Kokusai Securities.
